The '''R-Duba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Quiberon sector/Legends|Quiberon sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[R-Duba]].<ref name="Twitter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The R-Duba system first appeared in [[Droids (1986) 5|''Droids'' (1986) 5]], the fifth issue of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] comic series published by [[Star Comics]], an imprint of [[Marvel Comics]],<ref name="Separated">[[Droids (1986) 5|''Droids'' (1986) 5]]</ref> which was first published on [[December 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="Separated publication date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54155/star_wars_droids_1986_5|text=Star Wars: Droids (1986) #5}}</ref> It was first identified in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square T-15.<ref name="TEA" />
